title: Mind Over Material
html:
To accomplish anything, you must master the use ofmind power, which requires you to know exactly what it is you want.

To focus your mind power on a goal, you need to have a clear and well-defined goal, not just some vague notion about a dream or hope. After discovering what you want to accomplish, you need to develop an action plan.

To effect such a change, you must plant a picture in your mind and vividly imagine the feelings you will experience when the goal is realised.

You need to see it accomplished.

What does it look like?

What does it feel like?

This process is self-fulfilling because it creates in the mind what is called Substance. In other words, the brain thinks it is real. You can almost smell, touch or see the subject. The picture is vivid and dynamic.

Visualisation makes it more credible to believe that it will happen, and so continues to drive you forward in the belief of its realisation. It also helps ward off the enemies of doubt, fear or anxiety.

Not everyone can easily visualise clear mental images, but regular training of the imagination can do wonders, which is why repetitive advertising is so successful.

You may look at photos of what you want to achieve, close your eyes, and try to see it in your imagination. This will enhance your ability to visualise.

Creating neural pathways about the goal is what drives it. So you must keep up the visualisation practice to lock it in your brain and switch your opportunity sensors on. Because once they're turned on, you will start seeing things and meeting people who will help you achieve your goals.

The fact is, no one can tell you what you can't do tomorrow once you reprogram your brain - they can only tell how you have performed up till now.

To effect a positive outcome, you have to programme your brain with significant, positive neural pathways about almost everything imaginable.

Start today.
